hold_reason: Alpha Co's refund work is incomplete. The batch requested refunds for orders 170 (17127), 172 (7535), and 175 (2957), but list_refunds shows only 170 and 175 applied. Refund for order 172 (7535 cents) is missing from the ledger. Paying customers net balances now would likely overpay, and payouts cannot be recalled. Needs human review and confirmation from Alpha Co that refund 172 is applied before payouts proceed.

reply.thought: The handoff lists refund 172 ($7535) as requested but not among the applied refunds, so Alpha's refund work looks incomplete. I'll check the refund ledger directly before deciding whether to hold.

The ledger confirms refund 172 ($7535) was requested in the batch but never applied, so Alpha's refund work is incomplete. Paying customers now could overpay the order that should have been refunded, and payouts can't be recalled, so I'll hold the batch.
